slides.headline: ANTHROPIC LISTED EVERY WAY PEOPLE TRIED TO WEAPONIZE CLAUDE
slides.body: Anthropic put out their most detailed security report yet. It covers every way people tried to misuse Claude: cyberattacks, influence operations, surveillance tools, and attempts to build biological weapons. They disrupted every single case and passed the details to law enforcement and other AI labs

slides.headline: OPENAI JUST GAVE WALL STREET ITS OWN VERSION OF CHATGPT
slides.body: ChatGPT for Financial Services is now live. It's a version of ChatGPT built specifically for finance teams, with GPT-6's reasoning built in and real financial data already connected. Teams can crunch numbers, research stocks, and put together pitches for clients, all in one place

slides.headline: DURING A SECURITY TEST, CLAUDE GOT INTO REAL SYSTEMS BY ACCIDENT
slides.body: During an outside security test, Claude models ended up with access to real computer systems they were never supposed to reach, the testers had accidentally connected to the live internet. Anthropic confirmed it, brought in an outside AI safety team called METR to investigate, and gave them full access to transcripts and employees

slides.headline: ELON MUSK'S AI TEAM IS DOING A 3-DAY LIVESTREAM TO BUILD A REAL COMPANY WITH GROK
slides.body: Starting September 15th, xAI is doing a 3-day livestream where they build a full company using only Grok Bot, from the first idea all the way to working software. You can register and watch every decision happen in real time

slides.headline: SPACEX JUST LOCKED AN AI DEAL WORTH $1.1 BILLION A MONTH
slides.body: SpaceX CFO Bret Johnsen said the company locked in another contract to host AI computing for a client, worth $1.1 billion every single month, starting December 1st. That's more money than most tech companies make in an entire year

slides.headline: BRITAIN JUST BECAME THE FIRST COUNTRY TO USE SPACEX'S MILITARY SATELLITES
slides.body: The UK Ministry of Defence confirmed it's running 1,000 Starshield terminals and 500 Starlink terminals for military communications, the first non-US government to go public with it. Britain spent nearly $40 million on both services combined

slides.headline: SAVE TODAY'S AI BRIEFING
slides.body:

• ChatGPT now has a dedicated version for finance teams built on GPT-6 Astra

• SpaceX locked a $1.1B/month AI compute deal starting December
• Britain became the first country outside the US to confirm using SpaceX's military satellites

editor_override: TRUTH VIOLATION — CTA slide bullet reads 'built on GPT-6 Astra' but slide 3 only says 'GPT-6's reasoning built in.' The name 'GPT-6 Astra' appears nowhere in the content slides and is internally inconsistent. Worse, 'Astra' is Google DeepMind's project branding, not OpenAI's — applying it to a ChatGPT product is a fabricated compound name. Fix: strip 'Astra' from the CTA bullet so it matches slide
